boundaries.label: Four independent axes — never required to coincide

cards.title: Never Collapsed (Mission13 / M8.5)
items: DECISION AUTHORITY ≠ EXECUTION AUTHORITY ≠ SETTLEMENT KEY
An arbiter entitled to rule "buyer receives 70%" has never been shown authority over where the buyer receives it
Independent means never required to coincide — not that they must always differ

cards.title: M10 Extension — Information Access
items: Economic authority (who decided this) and information access authority (who may read about it) are distinct — the M10 read route never conflates them
The current historical semantic-record route authorizes trade parties only, deliberately narrower than current dispute access
Historical Arbiter Read Access Policy remains an explicit, undecided residual — not invented here

cards.title: Related, Not Redrawn Here — Outcome ≠ Execution Instance
items: An Outcome's meaning is fixed before execution (CORE_ARCHITECTURE.md §22)
A provider execution report is an Assertion, never world truth (§24) — Core may find correspondence, never establish the external world definitely behaved as claimed
This is a separate distinction from the four authority axes above, governing the same Provider boundary
